# routeros_interface_ethernet (Data Source)


## Example Usage
```terraform
# Entries in the menu, narrowed by any attribute it returns.
# Omit `filter` to read all of them.
data "routeros_interface_ethernet" "example" {
  filter = {
    name = "example"
  }
}

output "interface_ethernet" {
  value = data.routeros_interface_ethernet.example.entries[*].name
}
```
